purpose: Tagger tags assigned to the cards/illustrations of fixtures/scryfall/mana-cost-absent-vs-zero.json, plus the full parent chain of each tag.
selector: oracle_tags: taggings[].oracle_id ∈ fixture oracle ids; art_tags: taggings[].illustration_id ∈ fixture illustration ids. Per target, tags sorted by (tagging has annotation / non-median weight first, tag has parents first, slug) and capped at 15 oracle / 10 art tags. Ancestors = transitive closure over parent_ids. taggings[] filtered to the fixture targets. Available per target: 9728dec9…: 14 oracle tags; a3a98bc9…: 6 oracle tags; 058cdb0a…: 7 art tags; 679dad4c…: 12 art tags; 988614d8…: 10 art tags; ba23fb60…: 6 art tags.
note: Tag records are the original Tagger objects except: (1) taggings[] is FILTERED (see selector) and the fixture-added key `taggingsTotal` gives the unfiltered count; (2) child_ids[] is filtered to tags present in this file and the fixture-added key `childIdsTotal` gives the unfiltered count. parent_ids[] is complete: every ancestor is included, so the file is a closed sub-hierarchy in which child_ids is still the exact inverse of parent_ids. `taggingsTotal` and `childIdsTotal` are NOT source fields.

records.label: burst draw
records.description: Card draw effects that can net you a bunch of cards at once. As a rule of thumb, to qualify for this tag, the card should let you draw at least three cards at a time and come out ahead by at least +1.

records.label: castable from exile
records.description: Cards you can cast or access from exile.

records.label: cycle-tsp-no-mana-cost-suspend
records.description: A cycle of older cards, but now with suspend. (And no mana cost, so you have to use suspend)

records.label: inscryption achievement
records.description: Cards that share a name with achievements in the PC game Inscryption

records.label: intervening if clause
records.description: At/When/Whenever [event], if [clause], [effect].

records.label: pure draw
records.description: Spells and abilities that let you draw (a) card(s) without discarding other cards or sacrificing other permanents.

records.label: trigger from exile
records.description: Abilities that trigger from inside exile.

records.label: alternative cost
records.description: Spells with alternative casting costs, which may be cheaper or more expensive than their mana costs. See CR 118.9.

records.label: cast on resolution
records.description: Spells and abilities that let you cast spells as part of their resolution.

records.label: exile-self
records.description: Cards which exile themselves (from the battlefield, from the graveyard, from your hand, etc.)

records.label: force draw
records.description: Force an opponent to draw cards, whether they like it or not. The lesser used mode on Ancestral Recall.

records.label: more expensive than mv
records.description: The actual cost you pay for an effect (or for an alternate mode) will often be higher than the card's mana value. See also [cards with X in their mana cost](https://scryfall.com/search?q=m%3Ax).

records.label: single target instant/sorcery
records.description: Instant/sorcery spells that may target only one target. This is materially important for some effects that care about single targets. Not mutually exclusive with [multiple targets](/tags/card/multiple-targets).

records.label: spell with no casting cost
records.description: Non-land, non-extra cards that have no mana cost (as in, printed on the card).

records.label: french vanilla
records.description: These creatures, vehicles and spacecraft have only keyword abilities.

records.label: has identical token
records.description: A token exists that's identical to these cards. See more: [token versions of cards](token-versions-of-cards).

records.label: single english word name
records.description: Cards named with a single word in English. This may be a compound word.

records.label: type addition from none
records.description: Some creatures (Commonly artifact creatures) prior to the Grand Creature Type update were printed without Creature Types.

records.label: evasion
records.description: Creatures that are harder to block through keywords (flying, menace) or other means.

records.label: manaless value
records.description: Cards that can provide some amount of value without untapped lands.

records.label: artist signature
records.description: The artist's personal mark, identifying the work as their own. (Artist signatures might be cropped out in some versions of the same art.)

records.label: other fictional language
records.description: An otherwise unidentified fictional language in card art.

records.label: thopter
records.description: Small mechanical flying artifact creatures that inhabit many planes. Shorthand for "Ornithopter"

records.label: no one
records.description: Nobody is present in this art.

records.label: scale bird
records.description: Uses birds flying around the subject to demonstrate the subject's scale.

records.label: time spiral dominaria
records.description: The wastelands of Dominaria as depicted throughout the Time Spiral block.

records.label: halcyon
records.description: The capital of the Thran Empire

records.label: city
records.description: Depicts a distant city

records.label: fiora
records.description: The setting of Conspiracy, and birthplace of Dack Fayden.

records.label: aircraft
records.description: Various kinds of flying devices.

records.label: art media
records.description: Media used to render the artwork.

records.label: for scale
records.description: Uses objects of known size around the subject to demonstrate the subject's scale.

records.label: glyph
records.description: Characters that appear to be part of a writing system.

records.label: perspective
records.description: Tags describing art perspectives.

records.label: planar origin
records.description: Tags classifying the origins of creatures and objects from across the multiverse.

records.label: plane
records.description: A collection of art tags that relate to specific planes.

records.label: terisiare
records.description: A continent in the North of Dominaria, now flooded and turned into an [archipelago](terisian-isles) by the Thaw following the World Spell.

records.label: written language
records.description: Art containing visible text in any writing system.

records.label: card advantage
records.description: Things that give you access to more cards.  (The technical meaning of card advantage can be much broader than this, but this is what we're using here.)

records.label: card names
records.description: A collection of tags identifying properties and naming schemes in cards.

records.label: cycle
records.description: All the cycles from Magic history.

records.label: draw
records.description: Spells and abilities that textually draw you cards. See also [pure draw](pure-draw).

records.label: flavors of vanilla
records.description: Magic has various flavors of "vanilla", referencing cards with no abilities or only keyword abilities. For vanilla creatures (those with no abilities) see [is:vanilla](https://scryfall.com/search?q=is%3Avanilla) in Scryfall search.

records.label: token versions of cards
records.description: Some cards create tokens identical to existing cards (except for CMC). See: [cards creating these tokens](/tags/card/creates-token-of-a-card),  [printed tokens](/tags/card/token-version-of-a-card), and [the cards recreated in token form](/tags/card/has-identical-token).

records.label: type errata
records.description: Cards that were printed with a type-line that has since been updated. For cards whose token generation has changed, see [Token Errata](token-errata).

records.label: type errata addition
records.description: Cards that received a new type because it fit them, or because they were lacking one before.
